import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "input/test.csv"
SUB_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUB_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

# --- Validation Setup ---
# Hold out a stratified split for validation to compute the official metric
train_val, val_df = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["author"]
)

# Feature Extraction: Character n-grams capture stylistic authorship cues
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 4), max_features=80000, sublinear_tf=True, min_df=2
)
X_val_feat = tfidf.fit_transform(train_val["text"].fillna(""))
y_val = train_val["author"]

# Train model on validation split
clf_val = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=2000, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42)
clf_val.fit(X_val_feat, y_val)

# Compute Validation Metric
val_probs = clf_val.predict_proba(X_val_feat)
val_prob_df = pd.DataFrame(val_probs, columns=clf_val.classes_)
# Align columns to the required order before scoring
val_probs_ordered = val_prob_df[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]].values
val_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs_ordered)
print(f"Validation Multi-Class Log Loss: {val_loss:.6f}")

# --- Test Prediction ---
# Retrain on full training data for final submission
X_all = tfidf.fit_transform(train_df["text"].fillna(""))
y_all = train_df["author"]

clf_full = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=2000, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42)
clf_full.fit(X_all, y_all)

X_test = tfidf.transform(test_df["text"].fillna(""))
test_probs = clf_full.predict_proba(X_test)

# Format submission strictly according to requirements
submission = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=clf_full.classes_)
submission = submission[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]]
submission.index = test_df["id"]
submission.index.name = "id"
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUB_DIR, "submission.csv"), float_format="%.8f")
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
